snippet.title: Nightholme - First Gameplay Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Take a vicious little peek into Nightholme, courtesy of this pre-alpha gameplay footage from the delightfully disturbed minds at Studio Ellipsis.

This early look guides you through how a match unfolds, as you descend into a hungry city and wake what sleeps in the deepest dark. Along the way, you’ll glimpse the creatures stalking its streets and a few of the risks, rituals, and ruinous little pleasures that define our cosmic horror playground.

Nightholme is still in development. What you see here is a work in progress, still twitching on the slab. Features may shift, systems may evolve, and horrors are sure to multiply.

Inflict your thoughts upon us in the comments, and find us on the Nightholme Steam and Discord pages. To help us shape the thing before release, sign up for the closed beta linked below. 

Well then. Reach into the dark. That’s where the fun begins.

Wishlist Nightholme on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4108680/Nightholme/

Join us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/nightholme 

Closed Beta Sign-Up: https://nightholme.com/
